observations: The page number «XXV» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The introduction ends with L22; the rest of the page is blank.

L10: the final s of «alemannisches» is broken, its lower part not printed, with a light stain beside it; transcribed «alemannisches». L18: «minutae» and «secundae» in roman type, the Arabic words in italics.
Marks not transcribed: a dark speck in the left margin between L05 and L06, before «sischen».
